description: Variable speed drive: control word, speed and torque reference, ramp time, status and trip code, output frequency, current, torque and power, inputs, DC bus and temperature
source: Optidrive P2 Guia do usuário, version 3.10, section 9.2 (Modbus RTU)

sources.title: Guia do usuário do Optidrive P2

notes: Modbus RTU on the RJ45 connector (pin 7 RS485-, pin 8 RS485+). FC03, FC06, and FC16 for registers 1-4 only. Registers are numbered from 1, as in the guide.
Factory settings: address 1 (P5-01, up to 63; P5-16 allows higher addresses), 115200 bit/s (P5-03), no parity and 1 stop bit (P5-04).
Registers 1 and 2 control the drive only when P1-12 = 4 (Modbus RTU) and no fieldbus option module is fitted. Register 4 needs fieldbus ramp control (P5-07 = 1). Registers 6-24 can always be read.

Every user parameter is also a register: P1-01 is register 101, Px-yy is register x*100 + yy. Values with one decimal place are sent multiplied by 10. P5-01, P5-03 and P5-04 cannot be changed over Modbus. Only P1-01 is listed here as an example.
The Optidrive P2 is made by Invertek Drives and sold by Altus in Brazil. Written from the user guide; this map has not been tested on a device.

registers.name: Fast stop
registers.description: 1 = stop with the second deceleration ramp

registers.name: Reset
registers.description: 1 = reset an active trip; set back to 0 after the fault clears

registers.name: Ramp time
registers.description: Acceleration and deceleration time; used when fieldbus ramp control is enabled

registers.name: Trip code
registers.description: Number of the active trip; see the fault list in the user guide

registers.name: Digital inputs
registers.description: Bit 0 = digital input 1, and so on

registers.name: Pre-ramp speed reference
registers.description: Internal frequency setpoint; the guide gives no scale
